newsitem.title: USA: First USA begins tender for securities.
newsitem.headline: First USA begins tender for securities.

text.p: First USA Inc said on Monday it had commenced a tender offer for all of the 9.33 percent series A capital securities issued and 9.33 percent series B capital securities to be issued by First USA Capital Trust I, a Delaware business trust.
The tender offer is subject to completion of the previously announced merger of First USA and Banc One Corp, First USA said.
First USA said it has guaranteed the securities at $1,155 per $1,000 liquidation amount plus accumulated and unpaid distributions.
The tender offer and withdrawal rights will expire at 0900 EDT, on Monday, June 30, 1997, unless extended.

First USA's pending offer to exchange up to $200 million aggregate liquidation amount of the Trust's 9.33 percent series B capital securities for a like liquidation amount of the 9.33 percent series A capital securities issued by the trust in December 1996 will continue in effect.
The exchange offer and withdrawal rights will expire at 0900 EDT, on June 19, 1997, unless extended.
Merrill Lynch & Co is the dealer manager for the tender offer, First USA said.
